update_tgi_docs: run update_doc.py to regenerate the text-generation-launcher CLI, supported models, and OpenAPI documentation files
check_tgi_docs: run update_doc.py with the --check flag to verify all documentation files are up to date
update_cli_docs: run check_cli to regenerate the text-generation-launcher arguments markdown doc from the launcher help output
update_supported_models: run check_supported_models to regenerate the supported models markdown doc from the ModelType enum in the server code
update_openapi: run check_openapi to regenerate the OpenAPI JSON schema from text-generation-router and lint it with redocly
